footer.about: Premium grooming services in Espoo, Finland.

Haircut.name: Men Haircut
Haircut.desc: A professional haircut tailored to your style and face shape. Clean lines, modern techniques, and attention to detail. Leave looking sharp, confident, and refreshed.

Beard Trim.name: Beard Trim & Shape
Beard Trim.desc: Keep your beard looking clean, sharp, and well-groomed. Precision shaping tailored to your facial features. Perfect for maintaining a professional and stylish appearance.

Shave.name: Shave
Shave.desc: Experience a traditional close shave with premium products. Hot towel preparation and smooth razor finish. Relax, unwind, and enjoy the ultimate grooming experience.

Kids Cut.name: Kids Haircut
Kids Cut.desc: Fun, comfortable, and stylish haircuts for children. Gentle service designed to make kids feel relaxed. Kids 1-9 years: €10 | 10+ years: €25.

Haircut & Beard.name: Haircut & Beard
Haircut & Beard.desc: A professional haircut paired with precision beard shaping. The ultimate grooming package.
